name: efficiency-probe-1gpu
what_it_is: paper contribution 1: measured peak memory and throughput for six models at 4K/16K/32K/64K on ONE GPU, inference_mode with an untimed warm-up
why_a_fresh_run: every number in the efficiency table must come from this run rather than the training-shape calibration, which builds an autograd graph and calls backward -- it overstates inference cost and OOMed at 4096 for the loop arm
single_gpu_verified: the job reports gpu_count 1, so the per-device claim the probe is built for is backed by one card rather than by the 8-GPU shape the multiplexed design used
spec_chosen_because: a recorded 1-node generation-eval shape. The price API returns an empty shape list for this LCG, so the shape was identified from the specs that use it rather than enumerated -- and then CONFIRMED from the job's own gpu_count
checkpoint_override: NONLATENT_BIRWKV_RELEASE points at m4loop_ext_endpoint_ckpt, because the default is an in-repo release path that is not in this tree
oom_policy: an OOM is a row; only an import or load failure aborts the grid
